assay_conditions.assay: HSV-1 LacZ plaque formation / viral entry inhibition assay
assay_conditions.virus_input: HSV-1 inoculum; non-penetrated virus inactivated by low-pH citrate buffer after 45 min at 37 C
assay_conditions.readout: plaque numbers scored after X-gal staining; percent inhibition calculated versus no-peptide control
assay_conditions.replication: experiments performed in triplicate; error bars in Fig. 3 represent standard deviations
assay_conditions.source_review_note: Primary prose reports non-significant activity up to 500 uM; no exact bar value promoted.
